camera.comment: camera never moves; framing comes entirely from the Track To constraint

rotation_euler_deg.note: resolved by the constraint, not user-set

notes: Static 50 mm framing; the rider crosses the frame rather than being followed.
Motion blur is disabled; at 7-11 m/s each frame renders as a freeze.
Depth of field is off, so the whole depth of the scene is sharp.

cable_system.sag_note: scales with the square of the span at constant tension

rope.angle_note: measured on the water; shallower during the jump as the rider rises

method.velocity_acceleration: quadratic least-squares fit over a +/-4 frame window
method.raw_columns: accel_raw_ms2 / felt_g_raw are plain central differences
method.felt_g: specific force = a - g; 1.0 at rest, 0.0 in freefall
method.impulsive_flag: true near ramp entry, takeoff and landing, where the path is keyframed rather than simulated; acceleration there is an artefact of frame rate, not a physical force
